scope.description: Historical licensing inventory for source_commit, not the current package count or a final-image clearance.

rules.publisher_authorization: Original code Apache-2.0; authored documentation CC BY 4.0; third-party exceptions retained.
rules.local_prepare: No public redistribution of this component by the project; users obtain it under original-source terms. A download script does not grant new permissions.
rules.source_binding_due: A source license was located; the exact material and transformations still need to be bound to the chosen fixed source for release.
rules.authorship_scope: Copyright protects eligible expression; mathematical facts/methods and copied programs/documentation require distinct analysis. This review does not assert blanket clearance for every jurisdiction.
rules.copyleft_scope: Obligations apply to the covered work/derivative and binaries; independent files are not automatically relicensed.
rules.legacy_inventory: Prior source inventory was used for discovery, not treated as sufficient authorization.

solver_decisions.data: No clear redistribution terms were found for the official tool or the 100 public inputs; generating new seeds does not replace a license review of the code.
solver_decisions.code: `tools/src/lib.rs` is the official program; the origin of the scoring implementation still needs review.
solver_decisions.required_action: List only pinned sources and local preparation for the official tool and inputs; first review the scope of copied scoring code. Do not label it public until the issue is resolved.

solver_decisions.data: Original data is under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; prepare transformed data, packings, and table extraction locally under the arrangement already set for Lite.
solver_decisions.code: Handle project scripts and input materials separately.
solver_decisions.required_action: Retain the existing source chain and restrictions; exclude materials to be generated locally from every public layer.

solver_decisions.data: The official instance repository has CC0; its instances come from multiple upstream sources, so retain source records matched to the actual instances.
solver_decisions.code: No clear license was obtained for the separately downloaded verifier.cpp; the instance repository's CC0 does not apply to it.
solver_decisions.required_action: Integrate data by pinned version and hash; obtain the checker locally, or have the task owner independently implement it to specification and validate equivalence.

solver_decisions.data: Materials in the MiniZinc repository have MIT terms; no clear terms were obtained for the ZIB CALMA data source, so handle them separately.
solver_decisions.code: MiniZinc bundle components have separate terms; do not mark the entire bundle MIT.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare CALMA originals and transformations locally; match MiniZinc data to source files; add an inventory of bundle binary components and source.

solver_decisions.data: No clear redistribution terms were found for the official tool or inputs.
solver_decisions.code: `tests/scoring.py` is explicitly described as a behavior-faithful port of the official scorer; the scope of copied expression needs review.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare the official tool and inputs locally; deleting data alone does not resolve the ported scorer. Confirm the basis or implement it independently and compare results.

solver_decisions.data: The MIT license for gc_instances is explicit; this review could not confirm uniform distribution terms for the original CMU DIMACS data.
solver_decisions.code: Keep project judging code separate from input data.
solver_decisions.required_action: Match files individually to licensed data in the pinned gc_instances source; obtain unmatched originals and tables locally.

solver_decisions.data: A basis has been established for 20 corresponding CC BY data files; prepare comp11 and OptHub solutions locally.
solver_decisions.code: CPSolver LGPL, the specific dom4j BSD-style terms, and log4j 1.1 have been checked; no clear basis has been found for the old validator.cc.
solver_decisions.required_action: Use the Lite distribution arrangement and the CPSolver corresponding-source package; apply it to both online and offline packages.

solver_decisions.data: No uniform license applicable to this project's redistribution was found on the public CVRPLIB pages.
solver_decisions.code: The old LKH measurement tool is not included in the current task package and does not create additional release obligations.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare instances, external solution files, and their transformations locally from pinned sources; public download does not equal redistribution authorization.

solver_decisions.data: The official instances are public; this review found no clear distribution terms covering them.
solver_decisions.code: The license basis for the verifier.cpp downloaded from the official site is insufficiently clear.
solver_decisions.required_action: Obtain instances and official tools locally and preserve current checker results; any checker rewrite needs specific validation.

solver_decisions.data: The README in the pinned instance repository identifies sources but no LICENSE was found; the verifier's GPL does not establish the data license.
solver_decisions.code: The official verifier source is GPL-3.0 and currently includes UPSTREAM-LICENSE.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare instances and transformations locally; distribute source, build instructions, and the GPL notice with the checker binary.

solver_decisions.data: The README in the pinned instance repository identifies sources but no LICENSE was found; the verifier's GPL does not establish the data license.
solver_decisions.code: The official verifier source is GPL-3.0 and currently includes UPSTREAM-LICENSE.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare instances and transformations locally; distribute source, build instructions, and the GPL notice with the checker binary.

solver_decisions.data: No uniform, clear terms have been obtained for the official A/B/X data; the GPL-3.0 license in the fontanf repository cannot automatically be extended to all competition data.
solver_decisions.code: The champion implementation was not distributed according to the old inventory; do not misrecord historical solutions as bundled champion software.
solver_decisions.required_action: Obtain official inputs locally; retain the provenance of solutions_best and decide package scope only after checking the pinned source and the applicable data.

solver_decisions.data: No clear uniform redistribution terms were obtained for DIMACS10 / Walshaw data or reference tables; register generated inputs separately.
solver_decisions.code: The pinned KaHIP v3.25 commit has been verified as MIT.
solver_decisions.required_action: Prepare external data locally; retain the full copyright text and version with the KaHIP binary.

solver_decisions.data: RobinX's Repository is a backup of third-party instances, bounds, and solutions; its README's GPL statement concerns software and does not establish that all XML files are GPL-licensed.
solver_decisions.code: The RobinX README and actual onlineMain.cpp explicitly state GPL; the program's v3 notice matches the bundled GPL text.
solver_decisions.required_action: Retain checker source and build files; obtain instances and external solutions locally first. This data scope is more conservative than the old conclusion that the entire repository was GPL.

solver_decisions.data: ScheduleOpt/benchmarks explicitly uses CC BY-SA 4.0; the selected instances, tables, and transformations cannot be labeled Apache.
solver_decisions.code: OR-Tools has a separate software license; retain a separate notice for project-authored code.
solver_decisions.required_action: Include CC BY-SA, original sources, and conversion notes; adaptations to which the license applies remain under the same license, and bind the final data package to the corresponding original versions.

solver_decisions.data: The official IWLS 2022 / 2023 repositories use MIT; retain original attribution and conversion notes for the actual circuits and truth tables.
solver_decisions.code: ABC uses a UC Regents BSD-style notice.
solver_decisions.required_action: Provide the data after matching it to pinned sources; retain copyright.txt in the corresponding ABC build archive; do not include unused paper PDFs.

solver_decisions.data: No clear uniform redistribution terms were obtained for the DIMACS data sources.
solver_decisions.code: `mcqd_anytime.h` explicitly derives from Janez Konc's GPL-3.0-or-later code and lists three modifications; the central notice did not previously cover it.
solver_decisions.required_action: The MCQD original text and path mapping have been added; include modified source and build instructions with compiled binaries; prepare inputs locally.

solver_decisions.data: Only three OR-Library instances have an MIT basis; other families follow the Lite source-review findings.
solver_decisions.code: MQLib source is MIT; handle the paper and additional attachments separately.
solver_decisions.required_action: Follow the Lite local-preparation scope and existing source chain; build the image from a clean context.

solver_decisions.data: The official MSE 2026 Zenodo record 21358014 explicitly applies CC BY 4.0 to the data, metadata, and results archive; it does not cover the separate licenses of each included solver.
solver_decisions.code: Retain the original licenses and modification records for Open-WBO / MiniSat.
solver_decisions.required_action: For the files actually used, retain the eight supplement authors, original instance-family attribution, and transformation notes; verify the final inputs against the archive hash.

solver_decisions.data: Fixed public Google data is Apache-2.0; the project produced the reference solutions; obtain the problem PDF locally.
solver_decisions.code: The Google checker is Apache-2.0; file-by-file differences have been checked.
solver_decisions.required_action: Follow the existing Lite source chain, PDF exclusion, and clean-rebuild requirements.
